blockmuffler.message.key_disabled: The key you are trying to press is disabled right now! Please check the config.
blockmuffler.midnightconfig.areaKeybindO: Decides whether growing or shrinking an area uses the vanilla keybinds, or the way litematica does it, where you can hold a key configurable in keybinds, and scroll.
blockmuffler.midnightconfig.areaEditOpti: Uses either the side of the box the player is looking at, or the direction the player is looking, to choose which side to grow or shrink the box to.
blockmuffler.midnightconfig.hudAlignment: Decides where the 'Currently selected area:' text is rendered.
blockmuffler.midnightconfig.renderBoxSid: Disable to stop rendering the box (except the lines) when inside.
blockmuffler.midnightconfig.editmode.too: Disables/enables editing of areas with wand.
